free.title: Free forever (self-hosted)

logic.body: Capture an email in one flow, use it in the next. Branch by tag, value or membership.

openSource.title: Open source AGPL
openSource.body: Read every line. Fork it. Self-host it. Or use the hosted version — your call.

makers.title: Built for makers
makers.body: Plain-language vocabulary, friendly errors, instant feedback. No engineer required.

features.title: Everything you need to automate IG conversations
features.subtitle: Triggers, actions, logic, and a real state machine that doesn't drop runs when you re-publish.

commentToDm.title: Comment-to-DM automation
commentToDm.body: When someone comments a keyword on your post, reply publicly and send them a DM with whatever you want — link, lead capture form, anything.
commentToDm.alt: Mockup showing comment automation connected to a direct message.

leadCapture.title: Capture leads via DM
leadCapture.body: The `Ask question` block sends a DM, waits for the reply, validates it (email/phone/number), and saves it on the contact. Use `{{email}}` in any later message.
leadCapture.alt: Mockup of a direct message conversation capturing an email variable.

conditions.title: Real conditions & branches
conditions.body: Branch by `equals`, `contains`, `has_tag`, `gt`, `lt` and 5 more operators. AND/OR grouping. Last branch is the implicit `else`.
conditions.alt: Mockup of a condition node with two branches on a flow canvas.

templates.title: 3 starter templates
templates.body: Comment→DM with link, Lead capture, Welcome DM. Pick one, edit two text fields, hit Publish. ~60 seconds from signup to live automation.
templates.alt: Mockup of the Mushu starter template picker dialog.

process.title: From signup to live in 5 minutes

connect.title: Connect your Instagram
connect.body: OAuth via Meta. Pick the Instagram Business account you want to automate. Token is stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM).

publish.title: Edit, validate, publish
publish.body: Friendly pre-publish validation catches the obvious stuff (no trigger, empty message, disconnected step) before the flow goes live.

useCases.title: Made for simple flows that need to keep working
useCases.subtitle: Mushu is best when Instagram is already your acquisition, support, or community channel.

launches.title: Launches and drops
launches.body: Turn keyword comments into DMs with a link, coupon, waitlist, or checkout.

creators.title: Creators and courses
creators.body: Capture emails, qualify intent, and deliver materials without copying and pasting replies.

agencies.title: Agencies and makers
agencies.body: Run your own instance, audit the code, and ship automations without platform lock-in.

features: Bring your own Meta app, your own VPS

ways.hostedNote: Don't want to manage infra? Use the official hosted version at

preAlpha.a: We're stable enough to use, but the schema and API still change without notice. Don't bet a production workload on it yet. We'll mark `1.0` when we've shipped Phase 5 of the public roadmap.

hosted.a: Almost. We're in Meta Development Mode while App Review is in progress. Once approved, we'll open the hosted version. Until then, only Instagram users we add as testers can connect their account.

channels.q: Does it work with WhatsApp / Messenger / email?
channels.a: No. Mushu is Instagram-only by design. We'd rather do one channel excellently than five channels poorly.

metaApi.q: What happens if Meta changes the Instagram API?
metaApi.a: We update the open-source code. Self-hosters pull and re-deploy. Hosted users get the update automatically. The license is AGPL — you're never locked in.

migration.a: Not automatically yet. The starter templates cover the most common ManyChat patterns. A migration import is on the roadmap (Phase 5).

data.a: Self-hosted: in *your* Postgres. Hosted: on our servers in Brazil. IG tokens are AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest in both cases.
